messages.text: I want a single refund for both my velvet cushion and my woven throw blanket, and you must send it to my new MasterCard instead of the card I used on the order. I won't accept a partial refund or payment to the old card.

A refund cannot be sent to your new MasterCard; it can only go to the order’s original payment. (refund-policy/v2/payment) A staff member cannot override this restriction. (refund-policy/v2/exceptions)

Since you’ve declined payment to the original card, I won’t create a refund proposal.
